And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Retirement Manager Position**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Working as part of the Consulting team, you will take part in engagements related to a wide range of topics. Some examples of domains in which you will support our clients include the following:
  
  

* Defined Benefits Operations (E.g. - Benefits calculations, Benefits Review), Benefits Calculation for Retirement, Termination, Disability, Death, Divorce.
* ERISA Compliance - US Retirement Plan Testing (ADP & ACP Testing, Corrective Distribution) & Reporting experience.
* Deep understanding of in-plan guaranteed income products such as annuities embedded within defined contribution plans (e.g., target date funds with income guarantees).
* Experience in designing or evaluating protected retirement solutions through insurance-wrapped investment vehicles.
* Exposure to recordkeeping platform enhancements to support in-plan income features, including income projection tools, guarantee tracking, and participant-level income illustrations.
* Money in and Loans -Must have experience in handling money in & Loan related activities, i.e. Check processing, contribution, loan initiation, Loan repayments, re-amortization etc.
* Disbursements: Distributions/Disbursements such as Hardship withdrawals, QDRO, RMD, In-service distributions, loans or experience in processing 401K contribution, loan repayments etc.
* Understanding of business rules of Payout, Qualified/Non-Qualified Plans, Roth Conversion, Roth IRA, Fiduciaries, Defined contribution, Defined Benefits/Pension
* Exposure to Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) study and Public Pensions
* Understanding of plan administration, group and account setup, eligibility
* Understanding of Vesting rules and Investment management
* Knowledge of middle office and back-office processing (retirement account origination, servicing, funds payout, reconciliation of funds, etc.)
* Experience supporting or leading PMO functions for large-scale retirement transformation programs, including project planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting

Proven ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, scope, and quality standards in retirement platform implementations or upgrades
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Consulting Skills –**

* Experience in creating business process map for future state architecture, creating WBS for overall conversion strategy, requirement refinement process in multi-vendor engagement.
* Worked on multiple Business transformation and modernization programs.
* Conducted multiple Due-Diligence and Assessment projects as part of Transformation roadmaps to evaluate current state maturity, gaps in functionalities and COTs solution features.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Managing service delivery within the agreed service level across multiple blended processes
* Implement operational governance framework quality review mechanism, communication strategy.

**Technology Skills –**

* Proficient in technology solution architecture, with a focus on designing innovative and effective solutions.
* Experienced in data migration projects, ensuring seamless transfer of data between systems while maintaining data integrity and security.
* Skilled in data analytics, utilizing various tools and techniques to extract insights and drive informed decision-making.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices, ensuring data quality and compliance.
* Collaborative team player, able to work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions.

Industry certifications (ASPPA/LOMA/ RPF) will be added advantage.
  
  
Experience on these solutions is preferrable.
  
  
ALIS
  
  
OMNI

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**

title: Operations And Customer Success Intern
description:
**Operations & Customer Success Intern**

Company: Mentoria | Location: Kolkata (Remote + on-ground Saturdays)

Type: Internship, with paid freelance opportunities | Duration: 3-6 Months

Compensation: Stipend + freelance earnings per implementation

**ABOUT MENTORIA**

Mentoria is a leading career discovery and planning platform dedicated to helping individuals make informed career choices. We combine psychometric assessments, expert counselling, and an expansive knowledge base to guide students and professionals on their journey. Through our CSR and NGO partnerships, we also take career guidance to young people who have rarely had access to it.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is not a typical back-office internship. As our Operations & Customer Success Intern, you will be the voice that keeps students and parents supported through their Mentoria journey, from the first call to the final follow-up.

Alongside the internship, you will get paid freelance opportunities on our offline implementations with partner NGOs. Working with one of our counsellors, you will manage entire on-ground implementations with underprivileged girls in Kolkata, helping many of them think seriously about their future for the first time.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Customer Success

- Make customer success calls to students and parents, understanding their needs and guiding them through Mentoria's programmes.

- Make timely follow-up calls so every customer completes their journey and no one falls through the cracks.

- Handle queries and concerns with empathy and clarity, and escalate where needed.

2. Operations & Scheduling

- Schedule counselling sessions and coordinate calendars between counsellors, students and parents.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, sessions and follow-ups in our systems.

- Flag recurring issues and suggest small process improvements.

3. Offline Implementations (Paid Freelance)

- Manage end-to-end on-ground implementations with NGO partners, alongside a Mentoria counsellor.

- Coordinate logistics with the NGO team, including venue, participants, materials and timings.

- Support the counsellor during sessions with underprivileged girls, creating a safe and encouraging space.

- Be on the ground usually two Saturdays a month, with a maximum of three.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

- Based in Kolkata and able to travel within the city for on-ground Saturdays.

- Fluent in Bengali, Hindi & English is a plus.

- Confident on the phone, with clear and warm communication.

- Resourceful and quick on your feet, able to handle a schedule change, a difficult call or an on-ground situation calmly.

- Organised and dependable, with good follow-through.

- Comfortable with weekend field work.

As the on-ground work involves working closely with young girls, we are especially keen to hear from women candidates. Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

**WHY JOIN MENTORIA**

1. Real impact: Help underprivileged girls see that their future can be a choice.

2. Earning potential: Paid freelance work on offline implementations on top of your stipend.

3. Ownership: Manage full implementations, not just support tasks.

4. Growth: Learn customer success, operations and field counselling support from experienced professionals.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to vyomi.bhanushali@mentoria.com with the subject line "Ops & CS Intern – Kolkata". In 2–3 lines, tell us why this role matters to you.

title: Assistant Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The PRM & SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (High Networth Individual) segment of the Personal Banking customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
  
  
All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**
The bank seeks to grow business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
  
  
The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
  
  
We should also recognize our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.
  
  
The range of competitors and products has established an increased financial awareness in clients, creating demand for increased experience and skill at PRM level.
  
  
**A Premier Relationship Manager Requires The Following Key Attributes**

* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need

The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. As part of this wider team the jobholder is expected to identify opportunities in their day to day activities that directly or indirectly contribute to the success of colleagues with differing responsibilities, particularly in other areas of HSBC such as Commercial and Private Bank.
  
  
**Role Context**
The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more
  
  
**The Jobholder Has Prime Responsibility For**

* Maximizing growth in their portfolio and achieving the plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximizing all available resources.
* Compliance with the relevant Group standards including regulatory organization as applied to the implementation of the strategy in their country

Jobholder will hold Lending Approval authorities appropriate to their role.
  
  
The job holder operates within the approved operating and strategic plan process to develop the business.
  
  
**Management of Risk**

* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc..

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with relevant experience
* Minimum of 5-8 years of Relationship management work experience with high net worth clients.
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

**Accreditations**

* IRDA (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority) and AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds) certifications are mandatory

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

**Technical Capabilities**
**Global Wealth Management - Relationship Manager Technical Capabilities**
**Client Skills**

* Client focus
* Sales orientation
* Portfolio management
* Communicating & influencing

**Business Acumen**

* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding

**Solutions**

* Premier products and services
* HSBC services and propositions

**Processes**

* Risk and compliance
* Business processes
* Tools and systems

**Additional Information**

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment as Required

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Account Management - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Account Management - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth and maintaining a positive reputation for the organization. You will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, confirming their needs are met, and providing exceptional service. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will leverage your skills to develop and execute strategic sales and marketing initiatives, driving revenue growth and enhancing brand visibility.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will be responsible for building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality outcomes. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize market research, digital marketing, creative campaigns, and effective sales strategies to engage clients and achieve organizational targets. Your work will involve understanding client goals, managing accounts, and employing strategies to build trust and loyalty, ultimately contributing to the firm's success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as an independent contributor, liaising directly with the Account Manager, Lead Client Partner and account teams, taking end-to-end ownership of all activities for the accounts/ sector/industry they are align
* Act as a key liaison between offshore and onshore teams to align client priorities, account strategies and delivery expectations
* Partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to develop and execute strategic sales, account management and marketing initiatives
* Support Account Manager and LCP on account planning by conducting market research and analysis, pipeline and past sales analysis, tracking pursuits, and contributing to account strategy development
* Deliver and update accurate Salesforce reports, dashboards and account meeting materials, providing clear visibility into pipeline status, financials, client activities and follow-up actions
* Managing client accounts by understanding their goals and providing exceptional service to meet their needs- Utilizing analytical thinking and client profiling to develop strategic sales and marketing initiatives
* Engaging in sales account planning and sales enablement to capture new business opportunities- Collaborating with teams to execute creative campaigns and digital marketing strategies
* Applying critical thinking to break down complex concepts and generate innovative solutions
* Interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for client engagement strategies- Upholding professional and technical standards in all client interactions and account management activities.
* Navigating complex situations to anticipate client needs and deliver quality service.
* Leveraging customer relationship management tools to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty
* Lead a team of associates for account management deliverables, drive innovation in account management, and act as a coach to develop talent in the firm
* Be a champion of the firm’s standard business development methodology (Pursuit) and the use of sales best practices within your assigned clients
* Be an advocate and trainer for Salesforce, promoting its effective use, and support practice staff with advice and assistance on best practices

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least 5 years of relevant experience in sales support, marketing, account management, client engagement or a related role; relevant PwC or professional services firm experience may also be considered
* Demonstrated experience supporting client accounts, stakeholder relationships, sales operations, or business development activities.
* Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, Power BI.
* Effective project management and organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail, and Strong communication skills in English at Professional Level.
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Experience in using CRM technology to improve account management operations and data-driven insights to provide account visibility to support account growth.
* Working knowledge of financial analysis, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and account operations.
* Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and communicate practical recommendations to stakeholders.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, particularly in complex or time-sensitive situations.
* Self-awareness, learning agility, and a proactive approach to strengthening capabilities and addressing development areas.
* Build strong relationships and encourage effective teamwork.
* Executing projects as per defined guidelines and SLAs
* Analyzing and reporting data using dashboards and reporting formats
* Ability to work flexible shifts aligned with Canadian business hours, with coverage required until 1:00 a.m. IST; accordingly, the work day may begin later
* Demonstrating proficiency in client management and stakeholder engagement
* Utilizing analytical thinking to inform strategic decisions- Excelling in customer relationship management and satisfaction
* Developing sales account planning and sales enablement strategies
* Navigating complex client profiles and counseling needs- Building meaningful client connections through effective communication

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata
description:
As a Senior Manager/Associate Director - Revenue within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek
**Growth Architects**
—professionals who view regional business, platform operations, and marketing through the lens of data, engineering, and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics, and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization, and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute, and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns, and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic, and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* Commercial, Pricing & P&L Alignment
* Monitor performance metrics and financial margins across various categories to ensure regional growth is both competitive and accretive to the P&L.
* Liaise with central product, brand, and buying teams to negotiate optimal commercial terms, funding constructs, and localized SKU assortments.
* Strategically promote high-margin initiatives or products to systematically elevate the overall geography contribution profile.
* Data Modeling, Analytics & Platform Health
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting, and activation decisions.
* Maintain a strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Experimentation & Supply Operations
* Design and execute high-velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Coordinate meticulously with supply chain and internal teams to establish complete sync between live demand triggers and asset availability.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech / B.E. from IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institutes, or an equivalent heavily quantitative/analytical background.

**Experience & Competencies**

* Experience:4–8 years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech, or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset:Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Technical Savvy:Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency:Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain, and central product environments.
* Ownership & Grit:You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

**The Perks**

* Direct Impact:You aren’t just running campaigns or updating a dashboard; you are actively engineering the growth engine of an autonomous business unit.
* Intellectual Autonomy:We foster a high-trust, fast-paced environment where hierarchy takes a backseat—data and logical arguments always win.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Customer Manager
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You and this Role:**
As a
**Customer Manager – Consumer & Electronics and Mobility & Transportation**
to be located at Navi Mumbai/Bangalore and Pune, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth across strategic accounts and key market segments. You will work closely with OEMs, Tier suppliers, Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers and distribution partners to expand Dow's silicone solutions portfolio within Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Applications, Release Coatings, Elastomers, Railways, and other high-growth industries.
  
  
This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence market development, build strong customer partnerships, and contribute to Dow's growth strategy in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts while identifying new business opportunities.
* Develop strong relationships with OEMs, Tier customers, EMS partners, distributors, and key decision-makers.
* Create and execute territory and account growth plans aligned with business objectives.
* Identify and convert opportunities within target segments including Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Solutions, Elastomers, Railways, and Emerging Technologies.
* Lead opportunity pipeline management, pricing initiatives, contract negotiations, and commercial discussions.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Service & Development (TS&D), Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, and market assessments to identify growth opportunities and competitive insights.
* Drive customer engagement around innovation, sustainability, localization, and new product adoption.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Technical Sales, Application Development, or Customer-Facing Commercial Roles.
* Proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales processes, account planning, opportunity management, and value-based selling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to support customers and business growth initiatives.

**Preferred Experience:**
Experience in one or more of the following industries & product technology is highly desirable:
  
  

* Silicone and Specialty Chemicals
* Thermal Interface Materials
* Release coatings
* Silicone or other Elastomers.
* Electronics Materials
* EV and Mobility Solutions
* Consumer Solutions

**Your Skills:**

* Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities
* Strong commercial acumen with a growth-oriented approach
* Technical aptitude and ability to learn new technologies, applications, and market trends
* Proactive approach to identifying and developing business opportunities
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Ability to influence stakeholders and develop long-term customer partnerships
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

**Additional Notes:**

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.
* Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly organised, business-oriented professional to serve as a direct extension of the Founders and Sales Leadership team. This role combines strategic pre-sales support, business operations, cross-functional coordination, and end-to-end government and institutional tender management — making it a uniquely broad role suited for someone with strong execution orientation, commercial instincts, and experience navigating e-procurement ecosystems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales & Business Development Support
* Support Founders and Sales Leaders throughout the full sales lifecycle
* Coordinate customer presentations, technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, concept notes, and solution documents
* Work with Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams to gather technical inputs for proposals
* Maintain proposal repositories and sales collateral
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, PoCs, and strategic meetings
* Conduct market, customer, and competitor research
* Track strategic opportunities and follow-ups until closure
* Tender Management & e-Procurement
* Identify, track, and evaluate relevant government and institutional tenders across e-procurement portals — GeM, CPP Procurement Portal, MSTC, state portals (e-Tender WB, APTS, KTPP, eProcure, etc.)
* Manage end-to-end tender lifecycle: sourcing → eligibility analysis → document preparation → submission → follow-up → bid opening → post-tender correspondence

* Maintain and update tender tracking registers (ongoing, submitted, awarded, lost) with status and follow-up actions
* Monitor e-procurement portal portals and client websites for relevant tender notices — IoT, CAAQMS, environmental monitoring, smart infrastructure, IIoT sectors
* Liaise with government departments, PSUs, and institutional clients for tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and bid openings
* Maintain login credentials, DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) renewals, portal registrations, and vendor empanelments
* Coordinate with technical and legal teams to ensure all responses to pre-qualification questionnaires and technical queries are accurate and submitted on time
* Analyse lost tenders for lessons learned and support improvement of future bid strategies
* Maintain a repository of standard tender documents, pre-qualified certifications, and company credentials ready for rapid deployment
* Customer & Sales Operations
* Coordinate customer communications, documentation, and project discussions
* Support contract review by highlighting commercial, technical, and operational aspects
* Maintain CRM, opportunity trackers, and sales dashboards
* Coordinate seamless handover from Sales to Delivery
* Cross-Functional Program Management
* Drive execution across strategic initiatives
* Track deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate proactively
* Continuously improve internal coordination processes

**Requirements**

* Good hands-on experience working with Government clients
* Hands-on experience in bidding and government bidding portal/site management
* Experience in preparing deal collateral
* Notice Period: Immediate or shorter notice period preferred
* Language Skills: Bengali fluency is essential; must be fluent in English with strong vocal command for presentations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech with MBA — Mandatory

description:
**Company Description** 
  

  

 Nirmal Bang is one of India’s leading stock broking companies, serving both retail and institutional clients with a wide range of financial products and services, including equities, derivatives, commodities, currency derivatives, IPOs, NPS, depository services, and portfolio management services (PMS). Co\-founded and led by Dilip Bang and Kishore Bang, the firm is built on deep industry expertise and a strong culture of client commitment. The team brings together diverse professional backgrounds and experience, focusing on rigorous research and insight into local and global market developments. Nirmal Bang is a registered member of major Indian exchanges and depositories, and aims to help investors maximize returns through disciplined analysis and discovery of intrinsic value and growth opportunities.
   

  

**Role Description**
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in Kolkata. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of retail and/or institutional clients, understanding their financial goals, and recommending suitable products and services across equities, derivatives, commodities, currency, and other offerings. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include client onboarding, regular portfolio reviews, proactive communication on market developments, and coordination with research and operations teams to deliver timely and accurate information. The role involves generating new business through leads, referrals, and market outreach, while ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance standards. The Relationship Manager will also support clients with account\-related queries, documentation, and digital platform usage to provide a seamless investing experience.
   

  

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and long\-term partnerships.
* Sound understanding of capital markets and financial products such as equities, derivatives, commodities, currency derivatives, IPOs, NPS, and PMS.
* Sales and business development skills, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing, with a focus on ethical and compliant practices.
* Analytical and research\-oriented mindset to interpret market reports, economic trends, and company data for client advisory.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM, NCFM) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in broking, wealth management, or financial services relationship management is preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment in Kolkata, meet targets, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.

title: Advertising Account Manager
description:
As an advertising Account Manager, you'll work within an advertising or multi\-service agency, acting as a link between the agency and its clients. You'll be responsible for the coordination of advertising campaigns and therefore communicating clearly to all those involved. You may also be known as an account handler.
 



  





 It is vital to understand the needs of your clients, which you'll learn through liaising closely with them throughout campaigns, often on a daily basis. You'll also manage administrative and campaign work to ensure that advertising projects are completed on time and on budget.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As an advertising Account Manager, you'll need to:
 


* meet and liaise with clients to discuss and identify their marketing requirements
* work with agency colleagues to devise an advertising campaign that meets the client's brief and budget
* present (alongside agency colleagues \- particularly the account manager) the campaign ideas and budget to the client
* work with the agency heads to brief media, creative and research staff and assist with the formulation of marketing strategies
* liaise with, and act as the link between, the client and the advertising agency by maintaining regular contact with both
* ensure that communication flows effectively
* negotiate with clients and agency staff about the details of campaigns
* present creative work to clients for approval or modification
* handle budgets, manage campaign costs, and invoice clients
* write client reports
* monitor the effectiveness of campaigns
* undertake administrative tasks
* arrange and attend meetings
* make pitches, along with other agency staff, with the aim of securing new business for the agency.



  





**What to expect** 



* Although you'll generally be office\-based, travel within the working day is frequent as you'll be expected to visit clients and may attend TV shoots, radio recordings or castings. Absence from home overnight and overseas work or travel is occasionally required.
* The working environment is generally informal, although the smart dress is often the norm. The role can involve socializing with clients.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Although this area of work is open to all graduates, a degree or HND in the following subjects may improve your chances, especially as advertising is an increasingly competitive sector to enter:
 


* advertising
* business/management
* communications
* English
* marketing



  





**Skills** 




 You will need to show evidence of the following:
 


* excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* a proactive attitude, with the ability to use initiative
* excellent organizational skills
* the ability to work under pressure and assimilate large quantities of information quickly, while maintaining attention to detail
* drive
* flexibility
* effective teamworking skills
* influencing and negotiation skills
* oral and written communication skills
* commercial awareness
* a passion for advertising and an understanding of what makes a good advertisement
* a willingness to learn
* resilience, to enable you to deal with problems and constructive criticism
* IT literacy and an awareness of how the industry is developing in light of new communication technologies.



  





 Please apply with your CV to ankit@meraqi.in

title: Restaurant Onboarding Manager
description:
Experience Required: 3–6 Years
 



 CTC: 3\-3\.5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Gintaa** 




 At Gintaa, were redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission\-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and execution\-driven
 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager** 
 to lead Gintaa’s restaurant acquisition and onboarding operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**
